summary: Choose a visible cell rhythm and use clustered blocks to express larger silhouettes rather than scattering isolated cubes.
objective: The grid remains coherent at joins and selected blocks can be distinguished; detail does not collapse into flicker at the intended view.
intent_signals: Arrange grid-aligned blocks into readable forms
example_prompts: Create a voxel forest island using broad tree clusters and a readable stepped path.

principles: Choose a visible cell rhythm and use clustered blocks to express larger silhouettes rather than scattering isolated cubes.
This is an authored creative proposal, not a historical definition, fixed template or required rendering library.
implementation: Set a consistent cell scale for the main subject; use larger clusters for masses and purposeful stepped edges for detail.
Group cell colors by surface role and use light that separates steps without turning every cube into a competing highlight.
Frame the cell structure from an oblique view; snap edits to the authored grid while keeping camera motion independently smooth if desired.
observable_checks: The grid remains coherent at joins and selected blocks can be distinguished; detail does not collapse into flicker at the intended view.
Inspect the selected view and an alternate view at the intended output size before accepting the treatment.

known_limits: Proposed art direction only; no rendered artifact, runtime improvement or perceptual validation has been observed for this record.
Appearance choices do not certify factual geometry, material measurements or simulated behavior.
creative_affordances: Combine with retro-low-resolution rendering or minimalist color; a voxel appearance is not automatically volumetric measured data.
Adapt this proposal to the explicit user brief; combine or depart from it while preserving any factual and interaction contracts.
